create_distribution: create a Distribution subclass that computes probability values for game states
test_distribution_value: test the Distribution.value method returns a float probability for a given pyspiel.State
test_distribution_value_str: test the Distribution.value_str method returns probability for a state string with optional default
test_distribution_call: test the Distribution.__call__ method delegates to value and returns a float probability
test_parametric_distribution: test the ParametricDistribution.get_params and set_params methods for managing distribution parameters
